highlights_headline: Upcoming SkiaSharp changes strengthen hash-code seeding while preserving within-process hash stability.

bullets.detail: The HashCode polyfill compiled into SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp now uses RandomNumberGenerator instead of System.Random for its per-process seed. Hash codes remain stable within a process and randomized between processes. First use now loads cryptography support and adds initialization overhead.

contributor_summaries.rolfbjarne: Updated shared hash-code seeding to use operating-system randomness and enabled randomness analyzer checks for shipped code.
